definitions.explanation: A person with the ability to judge the quality or authenticity of things — especially art, antiques, food, or other specialized items. Also refers to the ability itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{骨董品|こっとうひん}→骨董品：06990_kottouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目利|めき}きだ。
examples.english: He is a connoisseur of antiques.

examples.japanese: ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目利|めき}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: Few people can judge the quality of fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店主|てんしゅ}→店主：12451_tenshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{目利|めき}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{確|たし}か→確か：00894_tashika⟧で、{良|い}いもの⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: The shop owner has a reliable eye for quality — only good items are on display.

notes:
USAGE:
Can refer either to the person ({目利|めき}き = connoisseur) or to the skill of judging ({目利|めき}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ = to be able to appraise). Commonly used in contexts involving antiques, art, gemstones, fish, and other items where expert evaluation matters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目利|めき}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{確|たし}か→確か：00894_tashika⟧ (having a reliable eye)
- {目利|めき}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (to be able to judge quality)
- {目利|めき}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧ (the ability to appraise)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鑑定|かんてい}→鑑定：16030_kantei⟧: appraisal — more formal, often professional
- ⟦{通|つう}→〜通：04025_tsuu⟧: connoisseur — broader term for someone knowledgeable
- ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a good eye — more casual expression
